$comment: NEW (formalised). The audio ID is the seam between Dev A's content and Dev D's studio. It has to be MECHANICAL — derivable from the content with no conversation — or the two streams block each other every week. This is that grammar, written as a regex CI can enforce.

namespaces.note: TWO clips per letter, always. The NAME (« té ») and the SOUND (« t »). Conflating them is the single most common error in phonics audio and it teaches the wrong thing: a syllabaire fuses SOUNDS.
The segmented reading: « t … a … ta ». Played on a correct syllable-build, and on demand by long-press. This is the clip that actually teaches fusion.

namespaces.slug: NFD → strip diacritics → lowercase → non-alphanumerics to '_'

rules: IDs are lowercase ASCII. Diacritics are transliterated, never embedded.
An ID is derived from content, never hand-assigned.
tools/generate-audio-manifest.ts scans content/ and src/i18n/ and emits every ID it finds with status 'missing'. Nobody types an ID into the manifest by hand.
CI fails if content references an ID absent from the manifest, and WARNS (does not fail) if the manifest holds an ID nothing references — orphans are cheap, gaps are not.
